Windows one-file release of VBA Add-in Editor. The ZIP contains `VBAAddinEditor.exe` and its SHA-256 checksum file.

## Fix: saves refused with "Deleted UserForm layout still present"

Some add-ins contain a UserForm layout with no code module, left behind by other tools. The save check took such a layout for a form you had just deleted, so every VBA save of that add-in failed with "The edited copy failed verification … Deleted UserForm layout still present". The original file was never changed.

- A form now counts as deleted only when you deleted it in the editor. Any other layout, including one with no code module, is kept and must stay byte-identical. A save that would drop it is refused.
- The Forms tab labels these forms **[layout only — no code module]**.
- A new or renamed module can't take the name of such a layout. The library would otherwise attach the new module to the old layout.

## Notes

- This is a development build, built and tested on GitHub's Windows runner. It has not been through the live Excel/PowerPoint qualification matrix.
- Known bug: a module whose code starts with a blank line fails save verification ("Body mismatch"). The original file is left untouched; remove the leading blank line and save again.
- Password-protected VBA projects remain read-only.
